name: vhup
description: vhangup(2) REVOKES THE CONTROLLING TERMINAL FROM THE FILES OPEN ON IT, 2.11BSD sys_inode.c vhangup and forceclose.  /testbin/vhup gives up its terminal, opens /dev/ttyp1 (which becomes its controlling terminal) and writes to it -- the positive control -- then calls vhangup.  The descriptor it held must answer EBADF, and a new open of the same slave must write: telnetd's open, vhangup, open.
